scope: BBSC Yharnam Together Ultimate BBHost playable track; NOT native port or production deployment

acceptance_tests: NAT-direct and symmetric-CGNAT two-client Windows routing; no duplicate sockets

alternatives.acceptance_gate: p95 connect-success across four NAT combinations, consent freshness, TURN cost, license, memory and CPU baseline

selected.implementation: one encrypted game link and server-directed relay

acceptance_tests: reliable and ACK remain single-path; 5 peers, loss/reorder/epoch/rebind/p99 relay throughput

alternatives.reason: route only explicitly eligible unreliable frames after signed peer grant and fresh Noise proof; reuse YT transport policy
alternatives.acceptance_gate: live original YT LinkAuth+game-frame integration and Windows NAT/relay fallback tests

alternatives.reason: BBHost's NP P2P socket is transport adapter, not an independent second world state/link policy
alternatives.acceptance_gate: one egress hook to select transport once and single receiver dedup

acceptance_tests: forged account ID, unauthorized join, replay, world/party epoch change, invitation filter

alternatives.reason: NP Matching2 API17 lifecycle cannot establish YT identity or override YT party admission
alternatives.acceptance_gate: network API16/17 cross-compat + target server protocol migration

alternatives.reason: signed permissions must be issued by selected YT authenticated session, not by independent peer service
alternatives.acceptance_gate: real team epoch and membership revocation, 5-player PK authentication

acceptance_tests: host migration, server restart/replay, boss death, flags, chalice, disconnected guest, no double writes

alternatives.reason: different host-owned progression with incompatible wire protocol and save semantics
alternatives.acceptance_gate: event-level equivalence with original game hooks; no second HP/flag owner

selected.implementation: five-player team roster, joins, deaths and invasions

acceptance_tests: 5 coop, 4+1, 3+2 gated by actual game slots; DBNO HUD persists until disconnect

alternatives.reason: its documented implementation counts only four player slots; adapt its per-invader reward/admission tests only
alternatives.acceptance_gate: five-player server roster membership and game-slot proof; game save/load and invasion refunds

acceptance_tests: same GPU scene 30/60/120, shader stalls, p95/p99 frametime, VRAM, driver hazard tests

alternatives.reason: competing shader recompilers and Vulkan ownership cannot simply coexist with BBHost
alternatives.acceptance_gate: isolated equivalent bug reproducer, frame-time and driver correctness on BBHost implementation

alternatives.reason: defer sampler GC if equivalent ownership hazard exists in BBHost; not a new texture manager
alternatives.acceptance_gate: same failing renderer race before/after and Vulkan validation

selected.implementation: native frame limiter, high-refresh rendering, input polling

acceptance_tests: offline 30/60/120/240/uncapped unchanged, online 60/120 max; frame p99 input latency measured

alternatives.reason: fix early BBHOST_GAME_FPS override bypass; update existing BBHost wanted_fps, not second limiter
alternatives.acceptance_gate: V455 compiled original-engine test plus real Windows gameplay timings

alternatives.reason: reuse frame pacing measurement ideas, never concurrently drive two engine frame clocks
alternatives.acceptance_gate: test one active authoritative step clock with Vulkan present and game NetSync

selected.implementation: guest mapping/protection epoch with CLS runtime glue

acceptance_tests: mapping snapshot atomicity, guest/stack boundaries, page protections, ASan/UBSan and game soak

alternatives.reason: avoid always-invalid cache and erroneous RW guest classification using existing BBHost generation; no second map table owner
alternatives.acceptance_gate: Windows in-game save/load stress and page-unmap races plus CPU measurements

selected.implementation: native game save read/write through BBHost guest IO

acceptance_tests: atomic save, permissions, corrupt/locked/full-disk, rollback, no shared-world substitution

alternatives.reason: backup/restore and NG+ snapshots are outside hot game save write path
alternatives.acceptance_gate: cryptographic backup verify, offline-only editor gating, cold recovery

selected.implementation: durable team world log and server-side snapshots

acceptance_tests: replay idempotent, restart, leader migration, no character save overwrite

alternatives.reason: host save/guest projection differs from YT server world log; avoid duplicate state authority
alternatives.acceptance_gate: map/boss flags replay with authoritative YT server and client solo state restoration

selected.implementation: YT cooperative trade and reward protocol

acceptance_tests: duplication/rollback after drop and client crash, server durable transfer id, no story-key transfers

alternatives.reason: gear+gem trade UX useful, but its docs warn ACK-loss rollback can duplicate inventory; must not add second ledger

selected.implementation: YT seamless game event build and mod overlay

alternatives.reason: host-only event ids and gameplay patch fingerprints can extend YT's current generator without parallel event engine
alternatives.acceptance_gate: active mod collision report, signed party fingerprint, host world-state authority

alternatives.reason: borrow useful profile switches and keybind accessibility, retain one launcher owner
alternatives.acceptance_gate: single canonical per-setting key and source-of-truth round trip
